tid_inbox_discord_welcome_body: Link your Discord account so you never lose your progress! Finish your first level, then open our Discord server and type /register followed by your game user ID. A 6-digit code will appear here in your inbox. If you reinstall the game, use /login on Discord to recover everything.

tid_inbox_discord_verify_body: Your lives counter now shows a 6-digit verification code. On the main screen, check your lives, then reply to the bot DM with that code to confirm your account link. The code expires in 5 minutes. Never share it.
